info.title: google_calendar (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Simulated google_calendar API for benchmarking. Derived from public documentation; no live service is called.

post.summary: Create a new Google Calendar. Provide a name and an optional description to initialize the calendar.
post.description: Create a new Google Calendar. Provide a name and an optional description to initialize the calendar.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific calendar by its ID. Returns the calendar's metadata and configuration details.
get.description: Retrieve a specific calendar by its ID. Returns the calendar's metadata and configuration details.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: The ID of the calendar to fetch.

get.summary: Retrieve all calendars the current user can access. Supports filtering by access role or inclusion of hidden and deleted
get.description: Retrieve all calendars the current user can access. Supports filtering by access role or inclusion of hidden and deleted calendars.

parameters.name: showHidden
parameters.description: When true, hidden calendars are included in the response.

parameters.name: showDeleted
parameters.description: When true, deleted calendars are included in the response.

parameters.name: minAccessRole
parameters.description: Only return calendars at or above this access role level.

post.summary: Create a calendar event from a plain-language text description such as 'Dinner with Michael 7pm on Friday'. Parses natur
post.description: Create a calendar event from a plain-language text description such as 'Dinner with Michael 7pm on Friday'. Parses natural language to infer event details.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: The ID of the calendar to add the event to.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Natural language description of the event to create.

parameters.name: sendUpdates
parameters.description: Controls which attendees receive notifications about the event creation.

200.description: Event: {success, event: {id, summary, start, end, attendees}}

post.summary: Create a fully specified calendar event. Schedule a new meeting, appointment, or occurrence with start/end times, attend
post.description: Create a fully specified calendar event. Schedule a new meeting, appointment, or occurrence with start/end times, attendees, location, recurrence rules, reminders, and other details.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: The ID of the calendar to create the event in.

200.description: Event: {success, event: {id, summary, start, end, attendees, location, ...}}

requestBody.description: {start: {dateTime: string, date?: string, timeZone?: string} (required), end: {dateTime: string, date?: string, timeZone?: string} (required), summary?: string (event title), description?: string, location?: string, attendees?: [{email: string, displayName?: string, optional?: boolean}], conferencing?: boolean (enable video conferencing), recurrenceFrequency?: 'daily'|'weekly'|'monthly'|'yearly', recurrenceUntil?: string (ISO datetime), recurrenceCount?: int, allDay?: boolean, colorId?: string, visibility?: 'default'|'public'|'private'|'confidential', remindersUseDefault?: boolean, remindersMethods?: ['email'|'popup'], remindersMinutes?: int, transparency?: 'transparent'|'opaque', guestsCanModify?: boolean, eventType?: 'default'|'outOfOffice'|'focusTime'|'workingLocation'|'birthday'}

get.summary: List or search events on a calendar. Filter by keyword, date range, or time window to find upcoming meetings and appoint
get.description: List or search events on a calendar. Filter by keyword, date range, or time window to find upcoming meetings and appointments.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: The ID of the calendar to query events from.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search term matched against summary, description, location, and attendees.

parameters.name: timeMin
parameters.description: Exclusive lower bound on event end time (ISO 8601). Returns events that end after this timestamp.

parameters.name: timeMax
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on event start time (ISO 8601). Returns events that begin before this timestamp.

get.summary: Fetch a single calendar event by its ID. Returns full event details including attendees, time, location, and description
get.description: Fetch a single calendar event by its ID. Returns full event details including attendees, time, location, and description.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: The ID of the calendar containing the event.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The ID of the event to retrieve.

200.description: Event: {success, event: {id, summary, description, start, end, attendees, location, ...}}

put.summary: Replace an existing calendar event with updated details. Modify the title, time, location, attendees, recurrence, or vis
put.description: Replace an existing calendar event with updated details. Modify the title, time, location, attendees, recurrence, or visibility.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: The ID of the calendar containing the event.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The ID of the event to update.

requestBody.description: {summary?: string, description?: string, location?: string, start?: {dateTime: string, date?: string, timeZone?: string}, end?: {dateTime: string, date?: string, timeZone?: string}, attendees?: [{email: string, displayName?: string, optional?: boolean}], recurrenceFrequency?: string, recurrenceUntil?: string, recurrenceCount?: int, allDay?: boolean, colorId?: string, visibility?: string, remindersUseDefault?: boolean, remindersMethods?: [string], remindersMinutes?: int, transparency?: string}

patch.summary: Perform a partial update on an existing calendar event, changing only the fields that are supplied.
patch.description: Perform a partial update on an existing calendar event, changing only the fields that are supplied.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: The ID of the calendar containing the event.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The ID of the event to partially update.

requestBody.description: Same as PUT but only provided fields are updated

delete.summary: Remove a calendar event. Cancels and deletes a meeting, appointment, or occurrence. Attendees can optionally be notified
delete.description: Remove a calendar event. Cancels and deletes a meeting, appointment, or occurrence. Attendees can optionally be notified.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: The ID of the calendar containing the event.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The ID of the event to delete.

parameters.name: sendUpdates
parameters.description: Who receives cancellation notifications: 'all'=every attendee, 'externalOnly'=only external attendees, 'none'=no notifications sent.

summary.description: Display name or title of the calendar.

description.description: A text description of the calendar's purpose or content.

timeZone.description: The IANA Time Zone Database name for the calendar's default timezone (e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles').

location.description: Free-form text indicating the geographic location associated with this calendar.

etag.description: ETag value used for caching and conditional requests.

accessRole.description: The current user's permission level for this calendar.

hidden.description: Indicates whether this calendar is hidden from the user's list.

deleted.description: Indicates whether this calendar has been deleted.

summary.description: The event's display name or title.

description.description: Additional details or notes associated with the event.

location.description: Physical or virtual location where the event takes place.

creator.description: Information about the person who created the event.

organizer.description: Information about the person who organized the event.

date.description: Used for all-day events in yyyy-mm-dd format.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database timezone name.

start.description: The event's start date and time.

date.description: Used for all-day events in yyyy-mm-dd format.

timeZone.description: IANA Time Zone Database timezone name.

end.description: The event's end date and time.

attendees.description: Collection of attendee objects, each with an email and optional responseStatus.

colorId.description: The color assigned to this event.

recurrence.description: Recurrence rules as RRULE, EXRULE, RDATE or EXDATE lines per RFC5545 (e.g. ['RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO']).

transparency.description: Controls whether the event blocks time as busy or shows the user as free.

conferenceData.description: Conference or video call details (e.g. Hangouts Meet, Zoom).

kind.description: String identifying the resource type of this collection.

nextPageToken.description: Cursor token used to fetch the next page of results.

nextSyncToken.description: Token used to synchronize incremental changes.

items.description: The set of calendars in this list.
